verifications.claim: Usher and Chris Brown have announced "The R&B Tour" (also referred to as The Raymond & Brown Tour) for 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "R&B artists Usher and Chris Brown have announced a joint stadium tour for 2026." (R1); "Usher and Chris Brown’s co-headlining stadium run titled ‘The R&B Tour’ ... Also marketed as “The Raymond & Brown Tour," (R2); "The R&B Tour, a 2026 co-headlining stadium run" (R3); "The R&B Tour - Starring Usher Raymond & Chris Brown" (R4); "R&B Tour (short for Raymond & Brown)" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the announcement, tour name, and Raymond & Brown reference for 2026.

verifications.claim: The R&B Tour is a 33-date co-headlining stadium tour across North America.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The tour includes 31 stops across the United States and two in Canada." (R1, totals 33); "33-date outing" (R3); "co-headlining stadium run" (R2, R3, R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state 33 dates (31 US + 2 Canada) as co-headlining stadium tour in North America.

verifications.claim: The R&B Tour kicks off on June 26, 2026, at Empower Field at Mile High in Denver, CO.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "kicks off on Friday, June 26 at Empower Field at Mile High in Denver" (R3); "June 26 - Empower Field at Mile High in Denver, Colo." (R1, R2, R4, R7)
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources directly confirm the exact kickoff date and venue.

verifications.claim: The R&B Tour concludes on December 11, 2026, at Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, FL.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: "wrapping up on Friday, December 11 at Raymond James Stadium in Tampa" (R3, R7); "wraps up Dec. 11 in Tampa, Fla." (R2); "12/11/26 - Tampa, FL @ Raymond James Stadium" (R4, last listed); but R1 lists "Dec. 11 ... Dec. 12 - Raymond James Stadium in Tampa"
verifications.reasoning: Most sources confirm conclusion on Dec 11 at venue, but R1 lists an additional Dec 12 show as final, creating contradiction.

verifications.claim: The R&B Tour features major stops in Los Angeles, New York, and Toronto.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Sept. 25 - SoFi Stadium in Los Angeles" (R1); "Aug. 7 - MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, NJ" (NYC area, R1-R4); "Aug. 11 - Toronto, Ontario — Rogers Stadium" (R2, R3, R4); "making stops in major cities including ... Toronto, ... Los Angeles" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Sources list stops in LA (SoFi), NYC area (MetLife East Rutherford), and Toronto.
